title: Feed view attaches the last try's next step to older refusal lines
description:
renderFeedView appends '— next:' from the tick's last try to every rejected/gate-failed line without checking the event's attempt, so try 1's rejection shows try 3's next step.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_drill.go:239-244
